It was originally made for Hyrulean knights unfamiliar with single-edged blades.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 50 |durability = 35 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Edge of Duality}} Edges of Duality are double handed [[Sheikah]] [[Weapon]]s that were crafted using Sheikah [[Ancient Technology]] for the [[Knight of Hyrule|Hylian Knights]], who were unfamiliar with the single edged blades traditionally favored by the Sheikah. They belong to the [[Sheikah Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by the Sheikah.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 170}} They have a brown blade, blue and gold handle, and a black cross guard. The swords themselves are carried in open black sheaths that, along with the cross guards, are engraved with the [[Crest of the Sheikah]]. Edges of Duality can be found at various locations within [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] and the [[Gerudo Highlands]]. One may also randomly appear inside a [[Treasure Chest]] if the {{SSB|-}} Series [[Sheik]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Edges of Duality are made of metal, and will therefore attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up again and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] Rune.
